en.review_status: Unreviewed model draft; not a scholarly reading. Underdots mark uncertain letters in apechometha, pollakis and emphaneie, with mixed script in emphainoith; the translation keeps them as read with hedged wording and leaves initial ar unrestored. Curly brackets around the final iota in emphaneie mark editorial handling of that letter; the translation follows the form without the bracketed iota. No question mark occurs in the supplied passage.
